thread:
ellen-partners: Heads-up: planning APAC compatibility sweep for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi ahead of marketplace onboarding. Goal: confirm firmware, driver, and power derate windows so we can finalize SKU tags. Propose Tokyo week May 13-17.

raj-ops: That week mostly free. Need to know fallback matrix in case H100/H200 nvlink breaks.

mei-mleng: We'll need kernel & CUDA variants listed. Current staging shows MI300 fw 1.2.3, Gaudi image gX-4. Mei will run image diff and perf smoke.

carlos-sales: Partner asked about co-marketing slot late May. We can't promise public dates until lab signoff and legal approves embargo.

dave-hw: Note: H100 -> H200 microcode differences can change power profiling. Suggest tests: (A) H200 microcode v2.4 (B) v2.3 fallback, (C) B200 fallback with nvlink link training.

lab-bot: lab-booking: reservations: tokyo-2: h100x2 h200x3 b200x1 mi300x2 gaudi_x2. window 2024-05-13T09:00 to 2024-05-17T18:00 JST. ID LAB-TYO-0524-08. Please ack.

ellen-partners: Action list: @mei-mleng run fw/driver probe by May 3, post diff. @dave-hw validate B200 nvlink fallback by May 5. @raj-ops confirm spare bench and cost by May 6. @carlos-sales draft partner quote options by May 7.

mei-mleng: Starting probe today, will paste checksum report if mismatch. If MI300 needs hotfix I'll flag for a staged image.

dave-hw: Running nvlink smoke now using nvlink-tool -nodes H20001,B20001 -firmware v2.4; will try v2.3 if fail and report.

raj-ops: Spare bench available in tokyo-3. Dry-run SLA best-effort; reserved capacity needed for strict SLA. Estimated cost for 5 days ~ $2k.

carlos-sales: I'll prep two embargo language options: conservative (no dates), optimistic (target regional availability late May). Legal loop once lab signoff.

ellen-partners: Sweet. If all green, we tentatively align partner announce hold for May 28. If any blocker, move to June. Please react to lab-bot with :white_check_mark: to confirm resources.
